title: European option Monte Carlo price with standard error vs Black-Scholes
deliverables: summary json: mc_price, standard_error, bs_price, abs_error, within_3se
frame: DIKETAHUI: S0, K, T, r, q, sigma, n_paths, seed, kind. DITANYAKAN: MC price, SE (currency), agreement flag. RUMUS: card Core 1-2: S_T = S0 exp((r - q - sigma^2/2)T + sigma sqrt T Z); Y = e^{-rT} payoff [n_paths]; price = mean Y; SE = std(Y, ddof=1)/sqrt N; toolkit bs_price, gbm_paths(n_steps=1). JAWAB: 1) rng = np.random.default_rng(seed) (or the named legacy API). 2) Z [n_paths]. 3) S_T, Y. 4) price, SE scalars. 5) within_3se = |price - bs| <= 3 SE. 6) write.
formulas: S_T = S0 exp((r-q-s^2/2)T + s sqrt(T) Z)
pitfalls: SE from undiscounted payoffs or ddof=0

title: Antithetic variates estimator and its standard error
deliverables: summary json: price_plain, se_plain, price_anti, se_anti, variance_reduction_factor
frame: DIKETAHUI: S0, K, T, r, q, sigma, N (pairs or total draws, read carefully), seed. DITANYAKAN: antithetic price, SE; efficiency vs plain MC. RUMUS: card Core 3: Y_i = (f(Z_i) + f(-Z_i))/2 discounted [N_pairs]; price = mean Y; SE = std(Y, ddof=1)/sqrt(N_pairs); plain SE on 2N_pairs independent draws for fair comparison. JAWAB: 1) Z [N_pairs]. 2) payoffs at Z and -Z. 3) pair means. 4) price, SE. 5) VRF = Var_plain/(2 Var(Y)) per equal cost. 6) write.
pitfalls: SE on 2N correlated draws understates error

title: Control variate with terminal stock price
deliverables: summary json: price_plain, se_plain, price_cv, se_cv, beta, rho_xy
frame: DIKETAHUI: S0, K, T, r, q, sigma, N, seed. DITANYAKAN: CV price and SE; beta. RUMUS: card Core 3: X = e^{-rT} S_T, E[X] = S0 e^{-qT}; Y = disc payoff; beta = Cov(Y,X)/Var(X) (ddof consistent); Y_cv = Y - beta(X - E[X]); SE = std(Y_cv, ddof=1)/sqrt N; variance reduction = 1/(1 - rho^2). JAWAB: 1) simulate S_T. 2) Y, X [N]. 3) beta. 4) price, SE. 5) rho^2 and reduction. 6) compare bs_price. 7) write.
pitfalls: using E[S_T] = S0 e^{rT} when q > 0

title: Arithmetic Asian MC with geometric Asian control variate
deliverables: summary json: price_plain, se_plain, price_cv, se_cv, geo_closed_form, beta
frame: DIKETAHUI: S0, K, T, r, q, sigma, n dates, N paths, seed. DITANYAKAN: arithmetic Asian price/SE plain and CV. RUMUS: card Core 1, 3, 4: paths on t_j = jT/n (exclude t0); A = mean_j S_j, G = exp(mean_j ln S_j); closed geometric: mG = ln S0 + (r - q - sigma^2/2)T(n+1)/(2n), vG^2 = sigma^2 T(n+1)(2n+1)/(6n^2); E[X] = e^{-rT}[e^{mG + vG^2/2}N(d1) - K N(d2)]; Y_cv = Y - b(X - E[X]). Toolkit gbm_paths, asian_geometric_price. JAWAB: 1) paths [N x n+1]. 2) Y, X [N]. 3) b, CV estimate. 4) SEs. 5) write.
pitfalls: geometric control on different dates than the arithmetic average

title: Variance reduction comparison table
deliverables: table by method: price, se, variance_ratio, efficiency
frame: DIKETAHUI: one option spec, N, seed; methods list (plain, antithetic, control variate, antithetic + CV). DITANYAKAN: per method price, SE, variance reduction vs plain. RUMUS: card Core 2-3; efficiency = 1/(Var x cost); antithetic + CV: apply CV regression on pair means. JAWAB: 1) draw Z once, reuse across methods (same budget). 2) compute estimator per method [methods]. 3) SE each with correct sample unit. 4) ratio SE_plain^2/SE_method^2. 5) check all prices within 3 SE of closed form. 6) write table.

title: Required number of paths for a target standard error
deliverables: summary json: pilot_se, required_n, ci_low, ci_high
frame: DIKETAHUI: option spec, pilot N0, seed, target SE eps (currency) or relative tolerance, confidence level. DITANYAKAN: required N; CI for price. RUMUS: SE = s/sqrt N; N_req = ceil((s/eps)^2); for CI half-width h at level c: N = ceil((z_c s/h)^2); CI = price +- z_c SE. JAWAB: 1) pilot run -> s = std(Y, ddof=1). 2) N_req. 3) optionally rerun at N_req and report SE <= eps. 4) CI. 5) write.

title: Exact GBM vs Euler discretisation error
deliverables: table by n_steps: euler_price, exact_price, bias, se
frame: DIKETAHUI: S0, K, T, r, q, sigma; step counts [L]; N, seed. DITANYAKAN: Euler price per step count, bias vs exact/closed form. RUMUS: Euler S_{j+1} = S_j(1 + (r - q)dt + sigma sqrt dt Z); exact log step S_{j+1} = S_j exp((r - q - sigma^2/2)dt + sigma sqrt dt Z); weak order 1: bias ~ c dt. JAWAB: 1) same Z across schemes per n_steps. 2) both terminal prices. 3) prices, SE, bias vs bs_price [L]. 4) regression of bias on dt. 5) write.
formulas: Euler: S += S((r-q)dt + s sqrt(dt) Z)

title: Stratified sampling of the terminal normal
deliverables: summary json: price_strat, se_strat, price_plain, se_plain
frame: DIKETAHUI: option spec, N, number of strata m, seed. DITANYAKAN: stratified price and SE. RUMUS: U_ij = (i + V_ij)/m, i = 0..m-1, V ~ U(0,1), n_i = N/m per stratum; Z = N^{-1}(U); price = (1/m) sum_i mean_j Y_ij; Var = (1/m^2) sum_i s_i^2/n_i; SE = sqrt(Var). JAWAB: 1) build U [m x n_i]. 2) Z, S_T, Y. 3) stratum means and variances (ddof=1). 4) price, SE. 5) compare plain. 6) write.
pitfalls: using naive std over all draws as SE

title: Importance sampling for deep out-of-the-money option
deliverables: summary json: price_is, se_is, price_plain, se_plain, shift_mu
frame: DIKETAHUI: S0, K >> S0, T, r, q, sigma, N, seed. DITANYAKAN: IS price and SE. RUMUS: sample Z ~ N(theta, 1), weight w = exp(-theta Z + theta^2/2); Y = e^{-rT} payoff(Z) w; choose theta = ln(K/S0) - (r - q - sigma^2/2)T over sigma sqrt T (centre at strike); SE = std(Y, ddof=1)/sqrt N. JAWAB: 1) theta. 2) Z shifted [N]. 3) weights, Y. 4) price, SE. 5) compare to bs_price and to plain SE. 6) write.

title: Quasi-Monte Carlo with Sobol points and randomised error
deliverables: summary json: qmc_price, qmc_se (over replications), mc_price, mc_se
frame: DIKETAHUI: option spec (possibly multi-step, dimension d = n_steps), N points, R replications, seed. DITANYAKAN: RQMC price, SE across replications. RUMUS: scipy.stats.qmc.Sobol(d, scramble=True, seed) -> U [N x d]; Z = norm.ppf(U); path by cumsum of log increments (Brownian bridge order optional); price_r per replication; RQMC price = mean_r, SE = std_r(ddof=1)/sqrt R. JAWAB: 1) N power of 2. 2) R scrambled sets. 3) prices [R]. 4) mean, SE. 5) compare plain MC SE at same N R. 6) write.
pitfalls: reporting a within-sample std as QMC error

title: Basket option Monte Carlo with correlated assets
deliverables: summary json: mc_price, standard_error, geometric_basket_cv_price
frame: DIKETAHUI: spots S [d], weights w [d], vols [d], dividend yields [d], correlation C [d x d], K, T, r, N, seed. DITANYAKAN: basket call price, SE. RUMUS: L = cholesky(C); W = Z L^T [N x d]; S_iT = S_i exp((r - q_i - s_i^2/2)T + s_i sqrt T W_i); B = sum w_i S_iT; payoff max(B - K, 0); optional CV with geometric basket (lognormal closed form). JAWAB: 1) validate C positive definite. 2) Z [N x d]. 3) terminal prices. 4) price, SE. 5) CV if asked. 6) write.
formulas: W = Z L^T, L L^T = C
pitfalls: Z L instead of Z L^T with row-vector draws

title: Random generator API and draw order reproducibility
deliverables: summary json: prices with the specified generator
frame: DIKETAHUI: seed and named generator (np.random.default_rng(seed) vs np.random.seed/RandomState), draw sequence spec (e.g. European Z first, then Asian increments). DITANYAKAN: MC outputs reproducible with the spec. RUMUS: card Conventions: one RNG created once; draws taken in stated order and shape ([N] then [N x n]); default_rng.standard_normal vs RandomState.standard_normal/randn give different streams. JAWAB: 1) instantiate exactly the named API. 2) draw arrays in the stated order and shape (row-major). 3) compute estimators. 4) re-run to confirm identical outputs. 5) write.
pitfalls: re-creating the generator inside a loop

title: Bump-and-revalue delta and gamma with common random numbers
deliverables: summary json: delta_fd, gamma_fd, delta_bs, gamma_bs, se_delta
frame: DIKETAHUI: S0, K, T, r, q, sigma, N, seed, bump h (absolute or relative 1%). DITANYAKAN: MC delta, gamma; compare BS. RUMUS: card Core 6: V(S0 +- h) with SAME Z; delta = (V+ - V-)/2h, gamma = (V+ - 2V0 + V-)/h^2; per-path difference gives SE of delta: std((Y+ - Y-)/2h, ddof=1)/sqrt N. Toolkit bs_greeks. JAWAB: 1) Z once. 2) three revaluations. 3) delta, gamma, SE. 4) compare bs_greeks within 3 SE. 5) write.
pitfalls: independent Z per bump -> noise swamps the Greek

title: Finite-difference vega, rho and theta by relative bumps
deliverables: summary json: vega, rho, theta in the requested units
frame: DIKETAHUI: option spec, N, seed, relative bump 1% of parameter. DITANYAKAN: vega, rho, theta in requested units. RUMUS: card Conventions: h = 0.01 x parameter; Greek = (P_up - P_dn)/(2h) in parameter units; vega per vol point = dV/dsigma/100, rho per 1% = /100; theta = dV/dt = -dV/dT, per day /365 (or /252). JAWAB: 1) same Z each leg. 2) bumped prices (sigma, r, T). 3) raw derivatives. 4) unit scaling per literal spec. 5) compare bs_greeks. 6) write.
pitfalls: theta sign: dV/dt negative for long vanilla

title: Forward vs central difference bias study
deliverables: table by h: delta_forward, delta_central, error_forward, error_central
frame: DIKETAHUI: option spec, list of bump sizes h [L], closed form available. DITANYAKAN: FD delta errors per scheme and h. RUMUS: forward (V(S+h) - V(S))/h error O(h); central (V(S+h) - V(S-h))/2h error O(h^2); with MC and CRN variance ~ O(1) for smooth payoffs, O(1/h) for digitals. JAWAB: 1) deterministic test first on bs_price. 2) then MC with CRN. 3) errors vs bs_greeks [L]. 4) log-log slope ~ 1 and 2. 5) write.

title: Greeks of a discontinuous payoff by finite difference
deliverables: summary json: fd_delta by h, lr_delta, closed_form_delta
frame: DIKETAHUI: cash digital spec, N, seed, bumps [L]. DITANYAKAN: digital delta estimates and SE per method. RUMUS: FD with CRN: variance of (1{S_T(S+h) > K} - 1{S_T(S-h) > K})/2h grows ~ 1/h; LR delta = e^{-rT} 1{S_T > K} Z/(S0 sigma sqrt T); closed form e^{-rT} n(d2)/(S0 sigma sqrt T). JAWAB: 1) FD per h with SE. 2) LR estimator and SE. 3) compare closed form. 4) recommend LR or larger h. 5) write.
formulas: LR delta = e^{-rT} 1{S_T>K} Z/(S0 s sqrt T)
pitfalls: pathwise delta for digital is zero a.s. (invalid)

title: Pathwise delta of a European call
deliverables: summary json: pathwise_delta, se, bs_delta
frame: DIKETAHUI: S0, K, T, r, q, sigma, N, seed, kind. DITANYAKAN: pathwise delta and SE. RUMUS: card Core 7: call D_i = e^{-rT} 1{S_T > K} S_T/S0; put D_i = -e^{-rT} 1{S_T < K} S_T/S0; delta = mean D, SE = std(D, ddof=1)/sqrt N; BS delta_c = e^{-qT} N(d1). JAWAB: 1) Z, S_T [N]. 2) D [N]. 3) delta, SE. 4) check within 3 SE of bs_greeks; delta_c in [0, e^{-qT}]. 5) write.

title: Pathwise vega and rho of a European option
deliverables: summary json: vega_pw, se_vega, rho_pw, se_rho, bs_vega, bs_rho
frame: DIKETAHUI: S0, K, T, r, q, sigma, N, seed. DITANYAKAN: pathwise vega, rho with SE. RUMUS: card Core 7: dS_T/dsigma = S_T(sqrt T Z - sigma T); vega_i = e^{-rT} 1{S_T > K} S_T(sqrt T Z - sigma T); rho: dS_T/dr = T S_T, discount -T: rho_i = e^{-rT} 1{S_T > K} K T (call); put rho_i = -e^{-rT} 1{S_T < K} K T. JAWAB: 1) Z, S_T. 2) per-path estimators. 3) means, SEs. 4) vs bs_greeks (rho_c = K T e^{-rT} N(d2)). 5) unit scaling. 6) write.
formulas: vega_i = e^{-rT} 1{} S_T (sqrt(T) Z - s T)
pitfalls: pathwise rho forgetting the discount term

title: Pathwise Greeks for an arithmetic Asian option
deliverables: summary json: price, se, delta, se_delta, vega, se_vega, gamma (null)
frame: DIKETAHUI: S0, K, T, r, q, sigma, n dates, N, seed. DITANYAKAN: Asian price, pathwise delta and vega with SE; gamma null. RUMUS: card Core 7: A = mean_j S_j; delta_i = e^{-rT} 1{A > K} A/S0; vega_i = e^{-rT} 1{A > K} mean_j S_j(W_j - sigma t_j), W_j = cumulative Brownian value at t_j; gamma: pathwise undefined -> null. JAWAB: 1) increments [N x n], W = cumsum sqrt(dt) Z. 2) S_j. 3) estimators. 4) means/SE. 5) checks: Asian delta < European ATM delta. 6) write.
formulas: vega = e^{-rT} 1{A>K} mean_j S_j (W_j - s t_j)
pitfalls: reporting pathwise gamma as 0 instead of null

title: Pathwise vs likelihood-ratio variance comparison
deliverables: table by method: delta, se, variance
frame: DIKETAHUI: option spec, N, seed. DITANYAKAN: delta (and vega) by pathwise, LR, FD-CRN with SE; variance ranking. RUMUS: card Core 6-8: PW delta e^{-rT}1{} S_T/S0; LR delta e^{-rT} payoff Z/(S0 sigma sqrt T); FD central with CRN. JAWAB: 1) same Z for all. 2) per-path estimators [N] per method. 3) mean, SE. 4) check Var_PW < Var_LR for smooth payoffs. 5) all within 3 SE of bs_greeks. 6) write table.

title: Likelihood-ratio delta and gamma
deliverables: summary json: lr_delta, se_delta, lr_gamma, se_gamma
frame: DIKETAHUI: S0, K, T, r, q, sigma, N, seed; payoff may be discontinuous. DITANYAKAN: LR delta and gamma with SE. RUMUS: card Core 8: Y = e^{-rT} payoff; delta_i = Y Z/(S0 sigma sqrt T); gamma_i = Y (Z^2 - 1 - Z sigma sqrt T)/(S0 sigma sqrt T)^2. JAWAB: 1) Z, S_T [N]. 2) Y [N]. 3) weighted estimators. 4) means, SE. 5) compare closed form (bs_greeks or digital Greeks). 6) write.
formulas: delta_LR = Y Z/(S0 s sqrt T)
gamma_LR = Y (Z^2 - 1 - Z s sqrt T)/(S0 s sqrt T)^2

title: Likelihood-ratio vega and rho
deliverables: summary json: lr_vega, se_vega, lr_rho, se_rho
frame: DIKETAHUI: option spec, N, seed. DITANYAKAN: LR vega and rho with SE. RUMUS: card Core 8: vega weight (Z^2 - 1)/sigma - Z sqrt T; rho weight Z sqrt T/sigma - T (the -T is the discount derivative); estimator = Y x weight. JAWAB: 1) Z, Y [N]. 2) weights [N]. 3) means, SE. 4) compare bs_greeks; LR SE larger than pathwise. 5) unit scaling. 6) write.
pitfalls: LR rho without -T

title: Mixed estimator: pathwise-LR gamma
deliverables: summary json: gamma_mixed, se, gamma_lr, se_lr, bs_gamma
frame: DIKETAHUI: option spec, N, seed. DITANYAKAN: gamma by mixed LR-PW and pure LR. RUMUS: differentiate pathwise delta D = e^{-rT}1{S_T > K}S_T/S0 with LR weight: gamma_mix = D Z/(S0 sigma sqrt T) - D/S0 (call); pure LR card Core 8. JAWAB: 1) Z, S_T. 2) D [N]. 3) mixed gamma [N]. 4) pure LR gamma [N]. 5) SE both. 6) compare bs_greeks gamma = e^{-qT}n(d1)/(S sigma sqrt T). 7) write.

title: Black-Scholes Greeks per contract with dividend yield
deliverables: per-contract table: price, delta, gamma, vega, theta, rho
frame: DIKETAHUI: S, K, T, r, q, sigma, kind [M]. DITANYAKAN: Greeks [M] with stated units. RUMUS: card Core 5: delta_c = e^{-qT}N(d1), delta_p = delta_c - e^{-qT}; gamma = e^{-qT}n(d1)/(S sigma sqrt T); vega = S e^{-qT}n(d1) sqrt T; theta_c = -S e^{-qT}n(d1)sigma/(2 sqrt T) - rK e^{-rT}N(d2) + qS e^{-qT}N(d1); rho_c = KT e^{-rT}N(d2); toolkit bs_greeks(S,K,T,r,sigma,kind,q). JAWAB: 1) d1, d2 [M]. 2) Greeks [M]. 3) unit scaling (vega /100, theta /365). 4) parity checks. 5) write.
pitfalls: vega/theta unit confusion

title: Greek unit conventions and rescaling
deliverables: summary json: raw and rescaled greeks with unit labels
frame: DIKETAHUI: raw Greeks (per unit of S, sigma, r, year) and the requested reporting units. DITANYAKAN: rescaled Greeks. RUMUS: card Conventions: vega per vol point = dV/dsigma / 100; rho per 1% = dV/dr / 100, per bp = /10000; theta per calendar day = dV/dt / 365, trading day /252; dollar delta = delta S; dollar gamma = 0.5 gamma S^2 (0.01)^2 for a 1% move or gamma S^2/100. JAWAB: 1) compute raw Greeks. 2) apply the literal formula in the spec over the prose label. 3) keep signs (theta negative long). 4) write with unit keys.

title: Put-call parity checks on Greeks
deliverables: summary json: residuals for each parity relation
frame: DIKETAHUI: S, K, T, r, q, sigma; MC or FD Greeks for call and put (same Z). DITANYAKAN: parity residuals. RUMUS: card Core 5: delta_c - delta_p = e^{-qT}; gamma_c = gamma_p; vega_c = vega_p; rho_c - rho_p = K T e^{-rT}; theta_c - theta_p = -rK e^{-rT} + qS e^{-qT}. JAWAB: 1) compute both sets with CRN. 2) residuals. 3) with CRN FD the identities hold exactly up to float; pathwise within SE. 4) write.
formulas: theta_c - theta_p = q S e^{-qT} - r K e^{-rT}

title: Asian option theta by rebuilt date grid
deliverables: summary json: asian_theta (per year and per day)
frame: DIKETAHUI: Asian spec S0, K, T, r, q, sigma, n dates, N, seed, dT bump (e.g. 1 day). DITANYAKAN: Asian theta. RUMUS: theta = -(V(T + dT) - V(T - dT))/(2 dT) or one-sided (V(T - dT) - V(T))/dT; dV/dt = -dV/dT; each leg rebuilds t_j = j(T')/n with the SAME Z matrix. JAWAB: 1) Z [N x n] once. 2) legs at T +- dT with rebuilt grids. 3) prices. 4) theta per year, per day. 5) check negative for typical long ATM. 6) write.
pitfalls: shifting dates without rescaling the grid

title: Discrete delta hedging simulation of a short call
deliverables: per-path array: pnl [n_paths]
summary json: mean_pnl, std_pnl, std_over_premium, quantiles
frame: DIKETAHUI: S0, K, T, r, q, sigma (both real and implied), n_steps rebalances, n_paths, seed, mu real-world drift (optional). DITANYAKAN: hedging P&L distribution (currency). RUMUS: card Core 9 and loop: at t0 receive premium bs_price, buy delta shares, cash = premium - delta S; each step cash *= e^{r dt}, dividend q S delta dt, rebalance to new delta (bs_greeks, T - t); expiry: liquidate, pay payoff; P&L = terminal cash. JAWAB: 1) paths [n_paths x n_steps+1]. 2) loop steps vectorised over paths. 3) P&L [n_paths]. 4) stats. 5) check mean ~ 0, std shrinks ~1/sqrt(n_steps). 6) write.
formulas: cash_{t+dt} = cash_t e^{r dt} - (delta_new - delta_old) S
pitfalls: rebalancing at expiry; forgetting final-day interest

title: Delta hedge with rebalancing every f days and rebalance count
deliverables: table by frequency f: n_rebalances, mean_pnl, std_pnl
frame: DIKETAHUI: daily price path(s) [N+1], K, T (N trading days), r, q, sigma_implied, frequencies f [L]. DITANYAKAN: P&L per frequency; rebalance counts. RUMUS: card Conventions: per day accrue interest -> credit dividend on shares from previous close -> rebalance if t % f == 0 (0 < t < N); T_rem = (N - t)/N x T; rebalance count = floor((N - 1)/f); toolkit delta_hedge_pnl(S_path, option_values, deltas, r, dt, hedge_freq). JAWAB: 1) option values, deltas per day. 2) loop for each f. 3) P&L, counts. 4) check std rises with f. 5) write.
pitfalls: counting t=0 or expiry as rebalances

title: Delta hedging with proportional transaction costs in bps
deliverables: summary json: pnl_gross, total_tc, pnl_net, n_trades
per-day table optional: shares, trade, tc, cash
frame: DIKETAHUI: price path [N+1], option spec, sigma, r, q, cost k_buy, k_sell in bps, frequency f. DITANYAKAN: total TC, net hedging P&L (currency). RUMUS: card Conventions: bps/10000; TC_t = k |dN| S_t with buy rate if dN > 0, sell rate if < 0; charged on initial trade, each rebalance, and terminal liquidation (sell); cash -= dN S + TC. JAWAB: 1) initial hedge with TC. 2) daily loop (interest, dividend, rebalance). 3) expiry: sell shares with TC, pay payoff. 4) P&L = terminal cash (undiscounted). 5) check TC decreases with coarser f. 6) write.
pitfalls: omitting TC on initial and terminal trades

title: Leland transaction-cost adjusted volatility
deliverables: summary json: leland_sigma, price_leland, price_bs
frame: DIKETAHUI: sigma, round-trip proportional cost k (decimal), rebalance interval dt, option spec, long or short. DITANYAKAN: Leland vol and price. RUMUS: card Core 9: short option sigma_L^2 = sigma^2(1 + sqrt(2/pi) k/(sigma sqrt dt)); long option uses minus sign; Leland number Le = sqrt(2/pi) k/(sigma sqrt dt); price = bs_price(sigma_L). JAWAB: 1) k from bps (round trip = buy + sell). 2) Le. 3) sigma_L. 4) price difference vs BS. 5) write.
pitfalls: using one-way cost when round-trip is required

title: Discrete hedging error scaling (Kamal-Derman / Boyle-Emanuel)
deliverables: table by n_rebal: simulated_std, theoretical_std
frame: DIKETAHUI: option spec, sigma, list of rebalance counts [L], n_paths, seed. DITANYAKAN: simulated P&L std vs theoretical. RUMUS: card Core 9: sd ~ sqrt(pi/4) vega sigma/sqrt(N_rebal) (vega = dV/dsigma); simulate hedging (realised = implied vol, no TC). JAWAB: 1) simulate hedge per N_rebal. 2) std(P&L, ddof=1) [L]. 3) theoretical [L]. 4) ratio and log-log slope ~ -1/2. 5) write.

title: Gamma-theta P&L attribution: realised vs implied variance
deliverables: per-day table: gamma_pnl, theta_pnl, total
summary json: cumulative attribution, actual hedge pnl
frame: DIKETAHUI: daily price path [N+1], option spec, sigma_implied, r. DITANYAKAN: daily attribution and total for a delta-hedged long option. RUMUS: card Core 9: daily P&L ~ 0.5 Gamma_t S_t^2 [(dS/S)^2 - sigma_i^2 dt]; total ~ sum e^{-r t} 0.5 Gamma S^2 (sigma_r^2 - sigma_i^2)dt; Gamma from bs_greeks at implied vol. JAWAB: 1) returns [N]. 2) Gamma_t, S_t [N]. 3) per-day term. 4) sum vs simulated hedge P&L. 5) sign: long gamma gains if realised > implied. 6) write.

title: Hedging at implied vs realised volatility on one historical path
deliverables: summary json: pnl_hedge_implied, pnl_hedge_realised, realised_vol
frame: DIKETAHUI: daily price path [N+1], K, T, r, q, sigma_implied (option bought at implied), realised vol estimate. DITANYAKAN: P&L hedging with implied-vol delta vs realised-vol delta. RUMUS: hedge with realised delta: P&L = V_BS(sigma_r) - V_BS(sigma_i) deterministic (if sigma_r known); hedge with implied delta: path-dependent sum 0.5 Gamma_i S^2 (sigma_r^2 - sigma_i^2)dt. Toolkit delta_hedge_pnl, bs_greeks. JAWAB: 1) realised vol from log returns (annualized_vol). 2) two hedge loops. 3) P&Ls. 4) write.

title: Delta hedging with discrete dividends credited on shares
deliverables: summary json: pnl, dividends_received
frame: DIKETAHUI: price path [N+1] with ex-dates and cash dividends D_j, option spec, r, sigma. DITANYAKAN: hedging P&L including dividends on shares. RUMUS: loop order: accrue cash e^{r dt} -> on ex-date credit D_j x shares held from previous close -> rebalance; option priced with escrowed S_eff (Core 10); short position pays dividends if short shares. JAWAB: 1) dividend schedule mapped to day index. 2) loop. 3) P&L, total dividends. 4) check no-dividend case reduces to base. 5) write.
pitfalls: crediting dividend on post-rebalance shares

title: Escrowed dividend pricing and hedge delta
deliverables: per-contract table: s_eff, price, delta
frame: DIKETAHUI: S, K, T, r, sigma, dividends (ex-date t_j, amount D_j) [J], valuation t, kind [M]. DITANYAKAN: price and delta [M]. RUMUS: card Core 10: S_eff = S - sum_{t_j > t} D_j e^{-r(t_j - t)} (strict >); price = bs_price(S_eff, K, T, r, sigma, q=0); delta = N(d1(S_eff)) (call), N(d1) - 1 (put) w.r.t. observed S, no extra e^{-qT}. JAWAB: 1) PV dividends within life. 2) S_eff [M]. 3) price, delta. 4) check no dividends equals BS. 5) write.
formulas: S_eff = S - sum_{t_j > t} D_j e^{-r(t_j - t)}
pitfalls: counting an ex-dividend on its own day; extra e^{-qT} on delta

title: Delta-gamma hedge with a second option
deliverables: summary json: n_option2, n_shares, residual delta, residual gamma
frame: DIKETAHUI: position Greeks (delta_P, gamma_P) or contracts to compute them, hedge option spec (delta_H, gamma_H), underlying. DITANYAKAN: quantity of hedge option and shares for delta-gamma neutrality. RUMUS: n_H = -gamma_P/gamma_H; n_S = -(delta_P + n_H delta_H); toolkit bs_greeks for each leg. JAWAB: 1) portfolio Greeks sum. 2) n_H. 3) n_S. 4) residual Greeks ~ 0. 5) optional: simulate P&L under a shock vs delta-only hedge. 6) write.

title: Delta-vega hedge with traded options
deliverables: summary json: hedge quantities, residual greeks
frame: DIKETAHUI: portfolio Greeks, two hedge options' Greeks, underlying. DITANYAKAN: quantities making portfolio gamma- and vega-neutral, then delta-neutral with stock. RUMUS: solve [[G1, G2],[V1, V2]] [w1, w2]^T = -[G_P, V_P]^T; then n_S = -(Delta_P + w1 D1 + w2 D2). JAWAB: 1) Greeks via bs_greeks. 2) solve 2x2 (np.linalg.solve). 3) stock quantity. 4) residuals. 5) write.
formulas: A w = -g, n_S = -(Delta_P + sum w_i Delta_i)

title: Realised volatility estimation for hedging
deliverables: summary json: realised_vol (decimal)
optional series: rolling vol
frame: DIKETAHUI: daily closes [N+1] (optionally high/low), annualisation factor (252), window. DITANYAKAN: realised vol (decimal, annualised). RUMUS: r_t = ln(S_t/S_{t-1}); close-to-close sigma = std(r, ddof=1) sqrt 252 (toolkit annualized_vol) or zero-mean sqrt(252/n sum r^2) when stated; Parkinson sigma^2 = (1/(4 ln 2 n)) sum ln^2(H/L) x 252. JAWAB: 1) log returns. 2) estimator per spec. 3) rolling if asked. 4) write.
formulas: Parkinson: s^2 = sum ln^2(H/L)/(4 n ln2) x 252
pitfalls: percent vs decimal output

title: Hedging P&L summary statistics and hedge effectiveness
deliverables: summary json: mean, std, std_over_premium, q05, q95, es_95
frame: DIKETAHUI: simulated P&L array [n_paths] from a hedge simulation, option premium. DITANYAKAN: summary stats. RUMUS: mean, std(ddof=1), relative hedge error std/premium, quantiles np.quantile, ES = mean of worst 5%; effectiveness = 1 - Var(hedged)/Var(unhedged). JAWAB: 1) compute unhedged P&L (premium e^{rT} - payoff) for reference. 2) stats both. 3) effectiveness. 4) write.

title: Stop-loss hedging strategy vs delta hedging
deliverables: table: strategy, mean_cost, std_cost, performance_measure
frame: DIKETAHUI: option spec (short call), real-world mu, sigma, rebalance interval, n_paths, seed. DITANYAKAN: PV hedging cost stats for stop-loss and delta hedge; Hull performance measure = std(cost)/BS price. RUMUS: stop-loss: hold one share when S > K, zero when S < K (trade on crossing at observed price); delta hedge as card Core 9; cost discounted to t0. JAWAB: 1) paths. 2) cost per strategy [n_paths]. 3) mean, std, ratio. 4) check delta-hedge ratio -> 0 as dt -> 0, stop-loss does not. 5) write.

title: Delta hedge P&L using toolkit on supplied option values and deltas
deliverables: per-day table: S, V, delta, shares, cash, portfolio
summary json: final pnl
frame: DIKETAHUI: path S [N+1], option value series V [N+1], deltas [N+1], r, dt, hedge frequency, sign of option position. DITANYAKAN: daily hedge account and final P&L. RUMUS: toolkit delta_hedge_pnl(S_path, option_values, deltas, r, dt, hedge_freq); portfolio = option position + shares + cash; daily P&L = change in portfolio. JAWAB: 1) align arrays. 2) call toolkit or replicate loop. 3) check sum of daily P&L = final. 4) write.
formulas: Pi_t = n_opt V_t - delta_t S_t + cash_t

title: Heating degree days index from daily temperatures
deliverables: per-day table: date, tavg, hdd
summary json: hdd_index per month/season
frame: DIKETAHUI: daily Tmax, Tmin [D] (C or F), base Tb (65F = 18.333C), period. DITANYAKAN: daily HDD [D], period index (degree days). RUMUS: card Core 11: Tavg = (Tmax + Tmin)/2; HDD = max(Tb - Tavg, 0); index = sum over the period. JAWAB: 1) units: convert base if temps in C ((F - 32) 5/9). 2) Tavg [D]. 3) HDD [D]. 4) sum per month/season. 5) checks HDD >= 0, Tmin <= Tavg <= Tmax. 6) write.
pitfalls: Fahrenheit base on Celsius temperatures

title: Cooling degree days index and CDD option payoff
deliverables: summary json: cdd_index, payoff (currency)
frame: DIKETAHUI: daily Tmax, Tmin for season [D], base Tb, strike K (degree days), tick (currency per DD), optional cap. DITANYAKAN: CDD index and option payoff. RUMUS: card Core 11: CDD = max(Tavg - Tb, 0); I = sum CDD; call payoff = tick max(I - K, 0), put tick max(K - I, 0), min(payoff, cap). JAWAB: 1) Tavg. 2) CDD [D]. 3) I. 4) payoff. 5) write.

title: Weather option pricing by burn analysis
deliverables: per-year table: year, index, payoff
summary json: mean_payoff, price, std_payoff
frame: DIKETAHUI: daily temperature history over Y years, contract period (months), base, strike, tick, cap, r, days to payment. DITANYAKAN: per-year index and payoff [Y]; burn price (currency). RUMUS: card Conventions: equal-weight years, no detrending unless asked; price = e^{-r days/365} mean(payoff_y). JAWAB: 1) filter period per year. 2) index_y [Y]. 3) payoff_y. 4) mean, std. 5) DF x mean. 6) write.
pitfalls: mixing years with missing days into the average

title: Burn analysis with linear trend detrending
deliverables: per-year table: index_raw, index_detrended, payoff
summary json: slope, price
frame: DIKETAHUI: index per year I_y [Y], target year y*, strike, tick, r. DITANYAKAN: detrended indices and price. RUMUS: OLS I_y = a + b y; detrended I_y' = I_y + b(y* - y); payoff on I_y'; price = DF x mean. Toolkit ols. JAWAB: 1) regression. 2) adjust each year to y* level. 3) payoffs, price. 4) compare undetrended. 5) write.

title: CME HDD/CDD futures and option tick value
deliverables: summary json: futures_value, pnl per contract
frame: DIKETAHUI: contract index (HDD/CDD) level or entry/exit index, number of contracts, tick per index point (CME US: USD 20). DITANYAKAN: contract value and P&L (currency). RUMUS: card Core 11: value = tick x index; futures P&L = n x tick x (I_exit - I_entry) x direction; option payoff = tick x max(I - K, 0) per contract. JAWAB: 1) index from temperatures if not given. 2) value/P&L. 3) write.

title: GHCN-Daily temperature cleaning and pivot
deliverables: table: date, tmax, tmin, tavg (C)
summary json: clean_days, expected_days
frame: DIKETAHUI: headerless GHCN-Daily records (station, date, element, value, flags), station id, months, year range. DITANYAKAN: cleaned daily Tmax/Tmin in C. RUMUS: card Conventions: values in tenths C -> /10; filter station, element in {TMAX, TMIN}, month, years; pivot by date; drop days missing either; optional quality flag drop. JAWAB: 1) read with explicit column names. 2) filter. 3) scale. 4) pivot, dropna. 5) count vs years x days_in_month. 6) write.
pitfalls: forgetting /10 scaling

title: Temperature OU model fit on deseasonalised anomalies
deliverables: summary json: kappa, sigma, seasonal params, n_pairs
frame: DIKETAHUI: daily Tavg series [D] over years. DITANYAKAN: seasonal mean, OU kappa and sigma (annualised). RUMUS: card Core 12: s(t) = A + Bt + C sin(2 pi t/365 + phi) by OLS on sin/cos, or day-of-year average; x = T - s; regress x_{t+1} - x_t = beta x_t + eps on adjacent same-year pairs; kappa = -beta/dt (or -ln(1 + beta)/dt), sigma = std(eps, ddof=1)/sqrt dt, dt = 1/365. Toolkit ols, ar1_fit, ou_from_ar1. JAWAB: 1) seasonal fit. 2) anomalies. 3) valid pairs. 4) beta, residuals. 5) kappa, sigma. 6) write.
pitfalls: cross-year regression pairs

title: Monte Carlo pricing of an HDD option under OU temperature
deliverables: summary json: mc_price, standard_error, mean_index
frame: DIKETAHUI: seasonal s(t), kappa, sigma, x_0 (today's anomaly), contract days [D], base, strike, tick, cap, r, n_paths, seed. DITANYAKAN: MC price and SE. RUMUS: card Core 12 exact step x' = x e^{-kappa dt} + sigma sqrt((1 - e^{-2 kappa dt})/(2 kappa)) Z; T = s + x; HDD daily; index sum; payoff; price = DF x mean; SE ddof=1. JAWAB: 1) Z [n_paths x D]. 2) loop days (accrue index from current x before advancing if day 1 uses x_0). 3) payoff [n_paths]. 4) price, SE. 5) write.
formulas: x' = x e^{-k dt} + s sqrt((1 - e^{-2 k dt})/(2k)) Z
pitfalls: Euler step instead of exact OU step

title: Weather option temperature delta and vega
deliverables: summary json: price, temp_delta (per 1 degree), vega (per sigma unit)
frame: DIKETAHUI: temperature model (s, kappa, sigma) or burn data, contract spec, n_paths, seed. DITANYAKAN: sensitivity to a parallel shift of temperatures (1 degree) and to sigma. RUMUS: delta_T = (V(s + 1) - V(s - 1))/2 with same Z; vega = (V(sigma(1 + h)) - V(sigma(1 - h)))/(2 h sigma). JAWAB: 1) base price. 2) bumped revaluations with CRN. 3) Greeks. 4) checks: HDD call delta < 0, CDD call > 0, vega > 0 for long options. 5) write.
